In this edition of India Angle by Sidhant Sibal, focus on India’s dual-track diplomacy, diaspora outreach, regional engagements and neighbourhood frictions.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi held telephone talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, reaffirming a human-centric approach and readiness to support dialogue. The leaders discussed food security, with Zelenskyy citing Russia’s Black Sea grain blockages.
